every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use identical camera paths, model placements, and card positions across frames 1 through 9, including the minor overlap of the card corner on the rack in frame 5.

explains_the_project.reason: While both use the same mechanical metaphor, the darker floor in frames 5, 6, and 8 of the second site gives stronger contrast to the 3D labels and colored routing lines that explain the pipeline.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Across frames 1 through 9, the lighter slate floor in the first site clearly receives cast shadows and grounds the dark blue machinery, whereas the dark floor in the second site swallows shadows and blurs dark silhouettes.

type_and_layout.reason: Although the UI cards and typography are identical across frames 1 to 9, the darker floor of the second site integrates seamlessly with the dark UI cards and makes in-scene 3D labels easier to read in frames 5 and 8.

overall.reason: With identical models, choreography, and UI, the first site wins because its lighter ground plane makes the dark 3D machinery, shadows, and spatial depth clearly legible instead of blending into a nearly black floor.
